Done. Tree is clean apart from the harness's own JSON envelopes; no new screenshots added.

## Result: zero new defects — no code changes were warranted

All 7 prescribed audits pass on 18 routes. **This is the sixth consecutive run with no new visual defect**, so rather than re-litigating them I confirmed them in one capped sweep and spent the run on the defect class that actually survives visual testing.

**What the prescribed audits measured**

| Audit | Result |
|---|---|
| 1 Icons | 0 foreign icons; 0 solid/other-library imports across 41 files; only the 2 documented inline `<svg>` |
| 2 Buttons | primary `.auth-btn` **identical on all 7 routes** — `oklch(0.72 0.19 250)` / 36px / 13px / 700 |
| 3 Header | `.topbar.glass` **56px on all 18**, `<h1>` on all 18 |
| 4 Sidebar | 18 links / 18 icons / identical gaps / exactly 1 `.is-active`; **collapse 240⇄68px verified working** |
| 5 Forms | **0 native `<select>`, 0 native date inputs**; 0 orphan `htmlFor`, 0 duplicate `id` |
| 6 Spacing | one systemic finding (below) |
| 7 Modals | 22 backdrops, `modal-scale-in 0.2s`; only the already-documented `h3`-vs-`h2` and blur variances |

**Audit 6's headline** — the app's root `font-size` is **14px, not 16px** (a live `p-5` probe computes 17.5px). Every fractional padding and card gap in the app is a Tailwind rem utility resolving against that 14px root, coexisting with the px `--space-*` tokens. That's one systemic thing, not N defects, and it retires a whole category of future false positives. Reconciling it means rewriting two working pages, so I left it — that's a refactor, which the charter forbids.

**Six new set differences, all clean** — frozen `useState` (7 hits, all dead code with no user-visible effect), buttons with no `onClick` (2, both false positives), controlled inputs with no `onChange` (**0**), overlay flags set-but-never-read (1, mobile-only), **form-submit integrity** (**0** — all 17 submit controls sit inside a form with `onSubmit`), and backdrop `onClick` without panel `stopPropagation` (**0** real — the 2 candidates use the sibling-backdrop pattern, where no propagation path exists).

**One trap worth flagging:** a naive comment/string stripper treats the apostrophe in JSX text (`Don't`) as a string delimiter and eats the rest of the file. My first pass reported 16 frozen-state hits; **9 were that artifact** and died to a one-line grep. Fixed in the kept harnesses. Since eating code can only *invent* "never called" hits and never hide one, this diff shape is a superset of the truth — every hit needs a raw-source grep before it's filed.

**Also surfaced:** 336 QA screenshots are *tracked* in the repo root, which is why `git status` has never shown them. Bulk deletion is your call, not mine.

Build **PASS**. Committed `8e9f287` (audit doc + 5 reusable harnesses); memory and resume notes updated. Charter deliverable is at `/tmp/ui-audit-results.txt`, archived at `docs/ui-audit-2026-08-20.md`.
